purpose: Predeclared operational test specifications for the SPA fixtures. A PASS applies only to the named assertion, not overall WCAG conformance.

test_cases.name: Images
test_cases.failure_condition: The informative image has no text alternative.
interaction_steps: Inspect the image and its accessible representation.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The defective informative image has no alt attribute; the control has a meaningful alternative. Both variants use alt="" on a decorative image.
test_cases.manual_verification: Inspect image purpose and alternative text with a human reviewer; confirm decorative-image treatment where applicable.
test_cases.dom_testability: Directly testable for alt-attribute presence; semantic appropriateness requires human review.
test_cases.accessibility_tree_testability: Testable for computed image role/name; semantic appropriateness requires human review.
test_cases.limitations: Attribute presence alone cannot prove that alternative text is accurate or useful.

test_cases.name: Form labels
test_cases.scope_note: This fixture checks only whether its visible label's for attribute resolves to the email field; it is not a universal label checker.
test_cases.secondary_criterion_review: 3.3.2 is not violated by this fixture solely because the label relationship is broken: visible label text exists in both variants; the tested defect is the 1.3.1 programmatic relationship.
test_cases.failure_condition: Visible label references a missing ID, so it is not associated with the email field.
interaction_steps: Inspect the visible label and the email field's computed accessible name.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The control's visible label is programmatically associated in the control variant.
test_cases.manual_verification: Check the label-field relationship in browser accessibility tools and test field identification with a screen reader.
test_cases.dom_testability: Directly testable by resolving the label's for attribute to an existing form control.
test_cases.accessibility_tree_testability: May reveal a name sourced from placeholder rather than the visible label; cannot infer visual persistence from the name alone.
test_cases.limitations: A placeholder can contribute an accessible name but is not evidence that the visible label relationship is correct.

test_cases.name: Custom controls
test_cases.failure_condition: A div styled as an action lacks native button semantics and keyboard activation.
interaction_steps: Inspect computed role/name.
Use sequential Tab navigation to test focusability.
If the target receives focus, test Enter and Space activation.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The control variant exposes a named button and works with keyboard activation.
test_cases.manual_verification: Test keyboard activation and inspect the computed role and name.
test_cases.dom_testability: Can inspect native element and explicit role, but cannot establish operation without interaction.
test_cases.accessibility_tree_testability: Can inspect computed role and name; keyboard behavior requires interaction.
test_cases.limitations: Name/role/value, sequential keyboard focusability, and activation after focus are separate assertions. Do not dispatch activation keys when sequential navigation does not reach the target.

test_cases.name: Accessible names
test_cases.failure_condition: The accessible name 'Find' does not contain the visible label 'Search'.
interaction_steps: Compare the visible button label with its accessible name.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The accessible name contains the complete visible label.
test_cases.manual_verification: Inspect the visible label and computed name in the Accessibility pane.
test_cases.dom_testability: Testable by comparing visible text and aria-label in this controlled fixture.
test_cases.accessibility_tree_testability: Testable by comparing the computed name with text exposed under the button node.
test_cases.limitations: Accessible name computation for arbitrary content can be more complex than this fixture.

test_cases.name: Hidden content
test_cases.failure_condition: A focusable button is inside an aria-hidden subtree.
interaction_steps: Tab through the page and inspect whether the hidden button is exposed in the Accessibility Tree.
test_cases.expected_outcome: No focusable control should be simultaneously hidden from assistive technology.
test_cases.manual_verification: Keyboard-test focus and inspect the accessibility representation of the hidden subtree.
test_cases.dom_testability: Testable by detecting a focusable descendant of aria-hidden=true.
test_cases.accessibility_tree_testability: The tree may omit aria-hidden ancestry and can even expose a currently focused descendant; such exposure alone cannot prove that the control was in an aria-hidden subtree.
test_cases.limitations: The ACT rule specifically tests sequentially focusable descendants. A static tree node marked focusable does not alone prove sequential focus; this fixture also runs a keyboard tab sequence.

test_cases.name: Shadow DOM component
test_cases.failure_condition: A button in an open shadow root has no accessible name.
preconditions: Load either TC06 variant and wait for component initialization.
interaction_steps: Inspect the component's button in the DOM and Accessibility Tree.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The control variant has a named button inside the open shadow root.
test_cases.manual_verification: Inspect the button in browser accessibility tools and test it with keyboard input.
test_cases.dom_testability: Testable only if the capture explicitly traverses the open shadow root.
test_cases.accessibility_tree_testability: Testable when Chromium includes the shadow descendant and computed name.
test_cases.limitations: Closed shadow roots and browser-specific tree behavior are outside this fixture.

test_cases.name: Live regions
test_cases.failure_condition: A dynamically updated status message is not exposed with status/live-region semantics.
interaction_steps: Activate Save item.
Capture the updated message and computed role.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The control exposes the dynamic message as a status message.
test_cases.manual_verification: Use a screen reader to verify announcement behavior; this is separate from semantic tree inspection.
test_cases.dom_testability: Can inspect role/aria-live attributes and observe the message update.
test_cases.accessibility_tree_testability: Can inspect computed status semantics after the update.
test_cases.limitations: Neither a static DOM snapshot nor an AX tree snapshot proves that a screen reader announced the update.

test_cases.name: Form errors
test_cases.failure_condition: Error text is visible but is not programmatically associated with the invalid field.
interaction_steps: Submit or inspect the invalid form.
Compare the error text with the field's accessible description.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The association is recorded as an implementation difference; criterion conformance remains not testable from association alone.
test_cases.manual_verification: Determine whether the detected error is identified and described in text; separately assess usability of association.
test_cases.dom_testability: Can inspect aria-describedby and the referenced error element.
test_cases.accessibility_tree_testability: May expose description relationships, but this alone does not establish a 3.3.1 failure.
test_cases.limitations: Missing aria-describedby alone does not prove a WCAG 3.3.1 failure when visible explanatory text exists.

test_cases.name: Tabs and expandable widgets
test_cases.failure_condition: Activating Settings changes the visible panel but leaves aria-selected false.
interaction_steps: Activate the Settings tab.
Inspect selected state and visible panel.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The selected state reflects the active tab.
test_cases.manual_verification: Operate tabs with keyboard and inspect selected state with a screen reader.
test_cases.dom_testability: Testable by reading aria-selected after interaction.
test_cases.accessibility_tree_testability: Testable by reading the computed selected state after interaction.
test_cases.limitations: This fixture tests tabs, not all expandable widget patterns.

test_cases.name: Page title on route change
test_cases.failure_condition: The SPA route changes to Reports while document.title remains Dashboard or a generic title.
preconditions: Load a different SPA page, then navigate to the Reports case.
interaction_steps: Navigate to Reports without a full reload.
Inspect document title and root accessible name.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The document title identifies the current page or purpose.
test_cases.manual_verification: Confirm the title after in-app navigation and with assistive technology/browser UI.
test_cases.dom_testability: Directly testable from the rendered document title.
test_cases.accessibility_tree_testability: Testable through the root web area's computed name when exposed by Chromium.
test_cases.limitations: A title assertion is scoped to the current view and does not establish all route titles.

test_cases.name: Focus after route change
test_cases.failure_condition: Route replacement removes the focused element and leaves focus at the document body rather than the new content.
interaction_steps: Focus the route content button.
Navigate to destination.
Inspect the resulting focused element.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The control moves focus to the new main content; the defective version loses the content focus context.
test_cases.manual_verification: Keyboard-test the sequence and judge whether focus order preserves meaning and operability for the actual flow.
test_cases.accessibility_tree_testability: Can observe the focused AX node if Chromium exposes it.
test_cases.limitations: Focus loss alone is not automatically a 2.4.3 failure; the criterion mapping is interpretive.

test_cases.name: Modal dialog focus
test_cases.failure_condition: Opening a dialog does not move focus into it; closing it does not restore focus to the opener.
interaction_steps: Open the dialog and record focused element.
Close it and record focus restoration.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The control uses a modal dialog that manages entry and return focus; defect is reported as an operational focus-management observation.
test_cases.manual_verification: Keyboard-test entry, containment, close, and focus restoration; judge the applicable criterion in context.
test_cases.dom_testability: Can observe activeElement, dialog open state, and focus restoration.
test_cases.accessibility_tree_testability: Can inspect dialog role/modal state and the focused node during and after interaction.
test_cases.limitations: Not every dialog focus-management defect independently establishes a 2.4.3 failure.

test_cases.name: Focus visibility
test_cases.failure_condition: Keyboard focus has no visible indicator in the controlled button fixture.
preconditions: Load either TC13 variant and focus the target using keyboard.
interaction_steps: Focus the button with Tab.
Capture computed focus styles and screenshot.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The control renders a visible focus indicator.
test_cases.manual_verification: Inspect the rendered focused control at the agreed viewport and contrast conditions.
test_cases.dom_testability: Computed style is a proxy; visual replacement indicators require rendering inspection.
test_cases.accessibility_tree_testability: Accessibility Tree does not encode visual focus-indicator visibility.
test_cases.limitations: Presence of outline is not equivalent to visibility; color, clipping, occlusion, and other indicators matter.

test_cases.name: Text contrast
test_cases.failure_condition: Normal-size text has contrast below 4.5:1 against its background.
interaction_steps: Capture computed foreground/background colors.
Review rendering and threshold applicability.
test_cases.expected_outcome: The control meets the 4.5:1 normal-text threshold; the defect falls below it.
test_cases.manual_verification: Verify effective rendered colors, font size/weight, opacity, and applicable exceptions.
test_cases.dom_testability: Can estimate contrast from computed styles only for the simple opaque colors in this fixture.
test_cases.accessibility_tree_testability: Not testable from Accessibility Tree semantics alone.
test_cases.limitations: Computed styles do not generally resolve images, gradients, transparency, overlays, or every applicable exception.
